description: A participating hospital bills the patient its full charge for the eye exam minus what Medicare paid, instead of the Medicare-approved deductible and coinsurance. The balance due therefore exceeds the deductible plus coinsurance printed in the same insurance summary; a reviewer should flag the difference as an assignment violation.

sources.what: Assignment: the reasonable charge is the full charge for the service (participating provider may not bill above the approved amount)
Under assignment the provider accepts the approved amount as full payment and collects only the deductible and coinsurance
Participating providers accept the Medicare-approved amount as payment in full; limiting charge for non-participating providers
Participation agreement and assignment on carrier claims
sources.source: CMS Medicare Claims Processing Manual, Pub. 100-04, ch. 1 §30.3, https://www.cms.gov/regulations-and-guidance/guidance/manuals/downloads/clm104c01.pdf
